settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_WALL_CLOCK_SECONDS
settings.description: How long one trust chain resolution may spend on the network, from when it starts: every fetch it causes, its peer chain and a Trust Mark validation's issuers and status calls included, ends by then; a resolution that runs out is refused as invalid_trust_chain

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 1 to 300: refused, naming the setting, when a trust chain validator is built - at start-up for most, on the first request that needs one for the rest

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_MAX_REQUESTS
settings.description: How many requests one trust chain resolution may spend: each statement asked for (from the cache or not) and each further request made to answer it, such as an authority's Entity Configuration to find its fetch endpoint

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 to 256: refused, naming the setting, when a trust chain validator is built - at start-up for most, on the first request that needs one for the rest

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_MAX_AUTHORITY_HINTS
settings.description: How many authority_hints of one Entity Configuration a resolution follows, after the configured trust anchors are moved to the front

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 to 64: refused, naming the setting, when a trust chain validator is built - at start-up for most, on the first request that needs one for the rest

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_MAX_ROUTE_ATTEMPTS
settings.description: How many routes that reach a trust anchor a resolution validates in full before it reports the first one's failure

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 to 64: refused, naming the setting, when a trust chain validator is built - at start-up for most, on the first request that needs one for the rest

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS
settings.description: The leeway allowed on an Entity Statement's iat and exp when a chain is validated

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 0 to 300: refused, naming the setting, when a trust chain validator is built - at start-up for most, on the first request that needs one for the rest

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_RESOLVE_SUBJECTS_PER_MINUTE
settings.description: How many distinct subjects the resolve endpoint (/federation/resolve) answers for one caller address in any minute: asking about one more is answered 503 temporarily_unavailable with a Retry-After, and asking again about a subject already counted in that minute is not counted again

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 to 10000: refused, naming the setting, on the first request to the resolve endpoint, which is answered 500

settings.name: OIDF_FEDERATION_RESOLUTION_RESOLVE_CACHE_SECONDS
settings.description: How long the resolve endpoint keeps a resolve response and answers the same request - subject, trust anchors, entity types and authenticated client alike - with it: this many seconds or until the response's exp, whichever is sooner; 0 keeps none

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number of seconds from 0 to 60: refused, naming the setting, on the first request to the resolve endpoint, which is answered 500
